package.name: camera_mount_description
package.description: URDF/xacro for the 2-DOF (yaw/pitch) Dynamixel camera mount, exported from the real OnShape design via onshape-to-robot (see onshape_export/ for the raw export used as the source of truth), with a RealSense D455 attached via realsense2_description's sensor_d455 macro for real camera TF frames. camera_mount.urdf.xacro exposes the mount as a xacro:macro (parent + origin) so it can be attached to any robot -- standalone here via camera_mount_standalone.urdf.xacro, later into the Unitree G1's own URDF once its head link and mounting offset are known.
